paper_kinds_hint.compulsory: Counts in the result; failing it may fail the whole result.
paper_kinds_hint.elective: A chosen subject that counts like a compulsory one.
paper_kinds_hint.optional: Adds a bonus to the GPA when passed; never fails the result.

list.title: Exams
list.text: Exams of a session: papers, mark sheets and how far marking is.
list.empty: No exams in this session yet
list.empty_text: Make the first exam, add its papers, then open it for marks.
list.no_sessions_text: Add a session under Education first; exams belong to a session.

exam.made: Exam made. Add its papers next.
exam.form_text: The session and campus stay fixed once the exam is made.
exam.name: Exam name
exam.campus_hint: The exam covers this campus and those below it.
exam.scheme_hint: Starts as your institution's default; pick another for this exam if needed.
exam.ends_before: The exam cannot end before it starts.
exam.draft_hint: Add the papers first. When you open the exam for marks, each paper gets a mark sheet for every section of its class.
exam.moderated: Handed-in marks wait for someone else to approve them.
exam.not_moderated: Handing in marks approves them at once.

marking.title: Open this exam for marks?
marking.text: Every paper gets a mark sheet for each section of its class, and teachers can start entering marks.
marking.done: The exam is open for marks.

closed.title: Close marking?
closed.text: Teachers can no longer enter or hand in marks. You can open it again later.
closed.unfinished: {count} mark sheets are not approved yet.

reopen.title: Open marking again?
reopen.text: Teachers can enter and hand in marks again.

paper.form_text: A subject for a class, with its marks and when it sits. The class and subject stay fixed once added.
paper.subject: Subject
paper.full_invalid: Enter full marks of at least 1, with up to two decimals.
paper.pass_too_high: Pass marks cannot be more than full marks.
paper.split_text: For example creative 70 + MCQ 30. Each part can have its own pass marks.
paper.empty_text: Add papers one by one, or make them all at once from a class's curriculum.
paper.from_curriculum_text: Adds a paper for each subject of the class's curriculum in this session (subjects already added are skipped).
paper.from_curriculum_none: Every subject of that curriculum is already here.
paper.delete_text: {subject} is removed from the exam with its mark sheets. A paper that has marks cannot be removed.

sheets.empty_text: Sheets are made for sections that have this paper's class. Check that the class has sections in this session.
sheets.none_here: No mark sheets with this status
sheets.not_open_text: Mark sheets appear once the exam is opened for marks.
sheets.assign_text: Choose who enters this sheet. Leave it on the class teacher to let them enter it.
sheets.send_back_text: The teacher sees your note, fixes the marks and hands them in again.
sheets.send_back_placeholder: For example: check Rahim's MCQ marks
sheets.own: You handed this in, so someone else must approve it.

entry.how: Type the marks and press Enter to go down. Type "a" for absent. Marks save by themselves.
entry.offline: No connection. {count} marks are kept here and will save when you are back online.
entry.not_saved: {count} marks are not saved. Fix them and they will save.
entry.invalid_format: Enter a number (up to two decimals) or "a".
entry.fix_first: Fix the marks shown in red, and wait until everything is saved.
entry.missing: {count} students have no marks yet. Enter their marks or mark them absent.
entry.hand_in_text: You cannot change them after this unless they are sent back to you. Someone else will approve them.
entry.hand_in_final: You cannot change them after this. They are approved as soon as you hand them in.
entry.exam_not_marking: The exam is not taking marks now, so these marks can only be read.
entry.not_yours: Another teacher enters this sheet, so you can only read it.
entry.status_open: These marks can only be read.
entry.status_returned: These marks can only be read.
entry.status_submitted: These marks were handed in and wait for approval.
entry.no_students_text: Students appear here once they are enrolled in the section.
entry.leave_text: Some marks are not saved yet. If you leave now they will be lost.
entry.published: Results are published, so these marks can only be read.
entry.published_correct: Results are published. To change a mark, use the pencil next to it and give a reason.

mine.title: My mark sheets
mine.text: The mark sheets you enter, in every exam open for marks.
mine.empty: No mark sheets for you right now
mine.empty_text: Sheets appear here when an exam opens for marks and you are the class teacher or the teacher chosen for a sheet.
mine.empty_no_hrm: Teachers are linked through HR. Ask your administrator to turn on HR and link your login to your staff record.

grading.title: Grading
grading.text: How marks become letters and grade points. Your country's published scales are ready to use; add your own if you need to.
grading.form_text: Each band starts at a percentage and runs up to the next one.
grading.name: Scheme name
grading.code_hint: Small letters, digits and _ only. It cannot change later.
grading.active: Can be picked for new exams
grading.bands_rule: One band must start at 0%, no two at the same percentage, and every band needs a letter.
grading.change_note: Published results keep their grades. Results not yet published use the new bands when they are worked out again.

results.title: Results
results.partial: You see only the subjects you teach for some students; their total, GPA and position are hidden.
results.no_rank: Positions are not shown (set by your institution's rules).
results.open_transcript: Open all results of this student
results.closed_text: Work the results out from the approved marks, check them, then publish.
results.published_text: These results are published. A mark changes only by a correction with a reason.
results.empty_text: Press "Work out results" to make them from the approved marks.
results.publish_text: Students and families will see them. After this, a mark changes only by a correction with a reason.
results.waiting_sheets: {count} mark sheets are not approved yet. Approve them before publishing.

combinations.title: Final results
combinations.text: Combine several exams of a session with weights, for example half-yearly 30% + annual 70%.
combinations.form_text: Pick the exams and how much each one counts. The weights must add up to 100%.
combinations.name: Name
combinations.empty: No final results in this session yet
combinations.empty_text: Make one when the exams it combines are published.
combinations.not_found: This final result was not found
combinations.no_results_text: Results appear once the exams it combines have results.
combinations.publish_text: Every exam it combines must be published first. Students and families will see the final result.

corrections.title: Mark corrections
corrections.text: Changes to published marks. Someone other than who asked approves each one; results are worked out again.
corrections.cannot: You can see these, but only people who publish results can approve them.
corrections.own: You asked for this, so someone else must approve it.
corrections.applied: Correction applied. Results were worked out again.
corrections.reject_text: The mark stays as it is. The person who asked sees your reason.
corrections.ask_text: Someone else approves it before the mark changes.
corrections.ask_text_now: The mark changes at once and results are worked out again.
corrections.asked: Correction asked. It waits for approval.
corrections.applied_now: Mark corrected. Results were worked out again.
corrections.why_placeholder: For example: marks were added wrongly on the script
corrections.same: That is the same as the mark now.

transcript.title: Student results
transcript.text: Every published result of a student and the cumulative grade point.
transcript.search: Find a student by name, ID or phone
transcript.none_found: No student found. Teachers find only students whose results they may see.
transcript.pick_text: Type at least two letters of a name, a student ID or a phone number.
transcript.cgpa_how: Counts each session's final result, or its final exams.
